屈辱的圣王（。“不死战王拳！”萧沉暴吼，挥拳迎击而上，拳意好似震动了三十三重天，永恒不朽，强横绝伦！他的身后浮现出一尊和他一模一样的盖世身影，宛若复生的大帝，战意滔天，横压九天十地！不死战王拳，是禁忌一脉独有的神术，和不死道骨全然契合，如今萧沉踏入了中位圣之境，能够发挥出这门拳术的最大威力了！符文冲天，纹络交织，拳意无匹，神威震世！这一拳轰出，萧沉的血液都如惊涛骇浪般，发出震天的咆哮之音！嘭！拳掌相击，西圣的神色瞬间就变了，本来是他以掌力强势镇压下来，可此刻却有凶猛而恐怖的劲力冲击而上，贯穿他的手臂，竟让他手臂上的肌肉都在抽搐！“真像一头猛虎啊。”西圣心惊。有瞥见二人战斗的强者也大为震惊，因为他们看见，那禁锢住萧沉道与法的枷锁好像变得更加虚幻了，有那么一瞬间，仿佛不存在了般！轰！萧沉的拳威兀然间变得更加强盛了，拳光炽烈，如一轮煌煌大日，西圣明明是自上而下拍落的一掌，此刻却有被镇压之感！（请）屈辱的圣王（第22页）从某种程度上来说，虚无空间并没有上下左右之分，若是从萧沉的方向来看，他亦可以算是在上！下一刻，西圣的身影被震飞出去，狂霸的拳劲贯穿他的道躯，竟让他的五脏六腑都裂开了！甚至，他的道躯都出现了裂痕，这可是强横的圣王躯，比寻常圣器都坚固，却被震裂了！“枷锁……他打碎了枷锁！”有人惊呼！没有了掣肘，没有了禁锢，萧沉的气息比先前澎湃了许多，精气神攀升到了一股可怕的境地，神魂都比大道熔炉都更加炽热！“禁忌！”霎那间，不少圣王投来了异样之色，越是强大的人越感到心惊，因为他们从萧沉的身上感知到了禁忌的气息！“那些枷锁，是在镇封禁忌的力量吗？”有圣王作出判断，现在枷锁崩开，禁忌的力量要真正展现出来了吗！“是大帝羲传承给他的吗？”太初神主等绝顶圣王都露出异色，这禁忌的气息，和大帝羲极为相似。众人内心皆动，一时竟忘了萧沉一拳轰飞了一尊圣王！就算是有缺的圣王，那也是真正踏足了这一层次的强者！轰！等到众人回过神来，意识到萧沉的战绩时，他已经挥拳而上，漫天符文闪耀，比星辰都璀璨，不死一脉的禁忌神力爆发，他的战王拳仿佛得到了升华，绽放出了毁天灭地之威！“他想杀西圣！”众人心神皆震，哪怕是圣王都不淡定了，萧沉轰飞圣王已然是了不得的大事，他竟还不满足，想在继续追杀，这是想要西圣的命吗？“这也太强悍了！”第二圣将都愣住了，一尊中位圣，竟然追着圣王杀，这还是他所熟悉的世界吗？“混账小子！”西圣喋血，见到萧沉杀来，他的脸色都涨红了，感到无比愤怒。被中位圣追着杀，古往今来，有这么屈辱的圣王吗？“你想死，我成全你！”西圣吼喝，心里发狠，一缕缕黑暗力量弥漫而出，他的眉心浮现出一个黑暗印记，竟像是活物般，能够发生变化。就在这时，萧沉携至强的拳威杀至，道威轰鸣，西圣的道躯竟被当场轰碎，化作碎块。但仅是片刻，西圣的身躯又在另一方位重组，且新的道躯竟比先前更加可怕，充斥着黑暗的气息。“故意不抵抗，想要借我的拳头，打破旧的躯壳，然后凝聚黑暗道躯吗？”萧沉自语，西圣被种下黑暗印记，意味着他的部分灵魂已经堕入黑暗，现在再加上黑暗道躯，他可以算是货真价实的黑暗圣王了。“是你逼我的。”西圣冷冽开口。“你想杀我，我也想杀你，你不是我的对手，被我击败，有什么逼不逼的。”萧沉淡漠开口，十分平静，“你这种状态，能够维持多久？”“不需你管！”西圣暴喝，身影暴掠而出，沿途所过之地尽皆化作黑暗，恐怖的道痕在黑暗中隐现，像是改变了天地大道的规则，让萧沉周围的空间都变得诡异起来！

Chapter 2486 The Humiliated Holy King (Page 1)
The humiliating Holy King (. "Immortal Fighting King's Fist!" Xiao Chen roared violently, swung his fist to meet the attack, and the power of the fist seemed to shake the thirty-third heaven. It was eternal and unparalleled in tyranny! A figure that looked exactly like him appeared behind him. , like a resurrected emperor, with overwhelming fighting spirit, overwhelming the nine heavens and ten lands! The Immortal Fighting King Fist is a unique magical technique of the forbidden lineage, and it is completely compatible with the immortal Taoist bones. Now that Xiao Chen has entered the realm of the middle saint, he can use this fist technique. The greatest power! The runes are soaring into the sky, the veins are intertwined, the fist is unparalleled, and the power is shocking! Xiao Chen's blood is like a roaring wave, and the fists and palms strike each other. It changed. Originally, he suppressed it with the power of his palm, but now there was a fierce and terrifying force impacting up, penetrating his arm, making the muscles in his arm twitch! "It's really like a tiger." west Shengxin! Shocked. The strong men who caught a glimpse of the two fighting were also shocked, because they saw that the shackles that imprisoned Xiao Chendao and Fa seemed to become more illusory, and for a moment, it seemed as if they no longer existed! Boom! Suddenly it became more powerful, and the light of the fist was blazing, like a bright sun. It was clearly a slap from the top down, but at this moment, I felt suppressed! (Please) Humiliated Holy King (page 22) To a certain extent! , there is no distinction between up, down, left and right in the void space. If you look at it from Xiao Chen's direction, he can be regarded as being up! The next moment, west Sheng's figure was blown away, and the powerful fist penetrated his body, causing his internal organs to break. They all cracked! There were even cracks in his Taoist body. This was a powerful holy king's body, stronger than ordinary holy weapons, but it was shattered! "The shackles...he broke the shackles!" Someone exclaimed! After being imprisoned, Xiao Chen's aura was much more surging than before, and his energy and spirit rose to a terrifying level. His soul was hotter than the furnace of the avenue! "Taboo!" In that moment, many saint kings looked at him with strange looks, and the more they became more intense, the more powerful they were. The powerful people felt even more frightened, because they sensed the aura of taboo from Xiao Chen's body! "Are those shackles suppressing the power of taboo?" A holy king made a judgment. Now that the shackles are broken, the power of taboo will be real. Is it showing? "Did Emperor Xi inherit it from him?" The supreme saint kings such as the Supreme Lord Taichu all showed strange expressions. This forbidden aura was very similar to that of Emperor Xi. Everyone was moved and for a moment they forgot about Xiao Chen flying away with a punch. A holy king! Even if he is a missing holy king, he is a strong man who has truly stepped into this level! Boom! When everyone came to their senses and realized Xiao Chen's achievements, he had already punched the sky, and the runes were shining brighter than the stars. The forbidden power of the Immortal lineage exploded, and his King of War Fist seemed to be sublimated, unleashing the power of destroying the heaven and the earth! "He wants to kill the Western Saint!" Everyone was shocked, even the Holy King couldn't calm down, Xiao Chen flew away. The Holy King is already a big deal, but he is still not satisfied and wants to continue to pursue him. Is this because he wants the life of the Western Saint? "This is too powerful!" The second Holy General was stunned. A middle-ranking Saint actually chased and killed the Holy King. How could this happen? Is this the world he is familiar with? "You bastard!" west Sheng was bleeding. His face turned red when he saw Xiao Chen coming to kill him. He felt extremely angry that he was being chased by the middle saint. Has there ever been such a humiliating saint king in the past? If you want to die, I will help you!" Xi Sheng shouted, his heart became fierce, and wisps of dark power filled the air, and a dark mark appeared on his eyebrows, which was like a living thing and could change. At this moment, Xiao Chen brought the strongestThe power of the fist came, the Taoist power roared, and west Sheng's Taoist body was shattered on the spot and turned into pieces. But in just a moment, west Sheng's body was reorganized in another direction, and the new body was even more terrifying than before, filled with the aura of darkness. "Deliberately not resisting, do you want to use my fist to break the old body and condense the dark body?" Xiao Chen said to himself, Xi Sheng was planted with a dark mark, which means that part of his soul has fallen into darkness. Now coupled with the dark body, he can be regarded as a genuine Dark Holy King. "You forced me." west Sheng said coldly. "You want to kill me, and I want to kill you too. You are not my opponent. If you are defeated by me, why can't you force me to do so?" Xiao Chen said indifferently, very calmly, "How long can you maintain this state?" "You don't need to worry about it!" Xi Sheng shouted, and the figure rushed out violently. All the places he passed along the way turned into darkness. The terrifying traces loomed in the darkness, as if the rules of the world were changed, making the space around Xiao Chen become weird!
